title: Fusion Reactor Simulator
description: A time-resolved fusion reactor simulation engine with a zero-dimensional power balance and a 1.5D radial transport model (T_e, T_i, n_e and poloidal flux on the normalised toroidal-flux coordinate) coupled to a fixed-boundary Grad-Shafranov equilibrium solver, with Sauter bootstrap current, NBI/RF sources, beam-target fusion, sawteeth, ELMs and NTMs. Covers magnetic confinement (tokamak, spherical tokamak, stellarator) and other schemes; verified against manufactured solutions and validated against ITER, JET DTE2, SPARC, EU DEMO and NIF. Includes a built-in publication-quality figure engine (SVG/PDF) and multi-core parameter scans.
